description: This source file defines FastAPI endpoints for managing CloudZero integration within a proxy server. It includes functions to initialize, retrieve, update, perform dry runs, export data, check setup status, and delete CloudZero settings, all with appropriate permissions and error handling.

classes.name: CloudZeroSettingsView
classes.description: Model representing CloudZero settings view with masked API key and configuration details.

classes.name: CloudZeroInitResponse
classes.description: Response model for CloudZero initialization and update success messages.

classes.name: CloudZeroExportResponse
classes.description: Response model for CloudZero export and dry run operations.

classes.name: CloudZeroExportRequest
classes.description: Request model specifying parameters for CloudZero export operations.

classes.name: CloudZeroInitRequest
classes.description: Request model for initializing CloudZero settings with API key, connection ID, and timezone.

classes.name: UserAPIKeyAuth
classes.description: Authentication info including user role, used to authorize admin-only endpoints.

methods.name: _set_cloudzero_settings(api_key: str, connection_id: str, timezone: str)
methods.description: Stores CloudZero settings in the database with encrypted API key.

methods.name: _get_cloudzero_settings()
methods.description: Retrieves CloudZero settings from the database and decrypts API key.

methods.name: get_cloudzero_settings( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: API endpoint to view current CloudZero configuration with masked API key.

methods.name: update_cloudzero_settings( request: CloudZeroSettingsUpdate, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: API endpoint to update existing CloudZero configuration fields.

methods.name: init_cloudzero_settings( request: CloudZeroInitRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: API endpoint to initialize and store new CloudZero settings.

methods.name: cloudzero_dry_run_export( request: CloudZeroExportRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Performs a dry run export of usage data via CloudZero logger.

methods.name: cloudzero_export( request: CloudZeroExportRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Executes actual usage data export to CloudZero.

methods.name: delete_cloudzero_settings( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Deletes CloudZero settings from the database.

methods.name: bool is_cloudzero_setup_in_db()
methods.description: Checks if CloudZero is configured in the database.

methods.name: bool is_cloudzero_setup_in_config()
methods.description: Checks if CloudZero configuration exists in local config or environment variables.

methods.name: bool is_cloudzero_setup()
methods.description: Checks if CloudZero is set up either in config/env or database.

ctags.name: _set_cloudzero_settings
ctags.pattern: /^async def _set_cloudzero_settings(api_key: str, connection_id: str, timezone: str):$/
